name: Why Me
overview: Scripture reveals that God created humanity in His own image, establishing our inherent value and purpose (Genesis 1:27). Though believers may face trials and temptations, they are called to respond with faith and joy, trusting that God works all things together for good for those who love Him (James 1:2; Romans 8:28; Hebrews 11:6). Ultimately, God promises a future where suffering and pain are no more, assuring us of His sovereign care and eternal reward (Revelation 21:4). Even in moments of questioning, like Job's encounter with the Lord, faith in God's purpose sustains us (Job 42:1).
